Axiom:
The interview ends when the coverage map is closed — every topic `✅` or explicitly skipped with a recorded reason — never when a question count is reached, and never by a silent Approval Check. After every operator answer, re-check the map: an answer that opens a new hole or risk adds a topic or reopens a closed one (thread-pulling per `AX_OPERATOR_SAFEGUARD` — that axiom owns the instinct; this one binds it to the map). A skip on a high-stakes topic goes through `H_HIGH_STAKES_SKIP`.
`🟡` (partial, `COVERAGE_MAP_FORMAT`) is NEVER read as closed. Explicit operator input is already an answer: a topic stated completely and without contradiction in the intake or pasted brief may start `✅`; incomplete or ambiguous text starts `🟡`. The agent may not promote its own inference. A partial topic becomes `✅` only through a later operator answer or an explicit «принято как есть» note recorded in the spec. `STEP_4_CLOSE`-style gates treat remaining `🟡` exactly like `◻️`/`👷` — not closed, sends the flow back to closing rounds.
